# Rasa Club

> Rasa is the cultural and artistic student club of ESTIN (École Supérieure en Sciences et Technologies de l'Informatique et du Numérique) in Amizour, Béjaïa, Algeria. Motto: “Feel the emotion. Live the expression.”

Rasa was created by students to ease the pressure of studies with a space for literature, art, music, chess, games, charity and cultural exchange. The club room is on the ground floor of the ESTIN library. Contact: rasa@estin.dz · Instagram @rasa.estin.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rasa-off.vercel.app/): about the club, events, the 2026/27 board, FAQ and contact form
- [Events](https://rasa-off.vercel.app/events): upcoming events and every activity of past seasons
- [Literature](https://rasa-off.vercel.app/literature): reading, book fairs, the Speaking Club, English/French/Arabic libraries
- [Art](https://rasa-off.vercel.app/art): drawings, paper quilling and members' artwork
- [Music](https://rasa-off.vercel.app/music): musical evenings and instruments
- [Chess](https://rasa-off.vercel.app/chess): training and the RASA Chess Cup
- [Activities](https://rasa-off.vercel.app/activities): games and tournaments
- [Charity](https://rasa-off.vercel.app/charity): solidarity campaigns with accredited associations
- [Register](https://rasa-off.vercel.app/registrations): join Rasa Club 2026/27 and pick a department

## Season 2025/26 (11 activities)

- Welcome Day: Oct 2025, ESTIN. Our first contact with the new students: every department presented, social games and new members recruited. (659 likes on the video)
- Movie Night: Oct 2025, ESTIN. A horror film chosen by the students themselves in an Instagram poll, to breathe before exam season.
- Algiers International Book Fair (SILA): Oct 2025, Algiers. A cultural trip to SILA: visiting the stands, meeting authors and publishers, and bringing books home.
- 1 November commemoration: Nov 2025, ESTIN. Speeches on the meaning of the Revolution of 1 November 1954 and heritage music, in a solemn atmosphere.
- Speaking Club: Nov–Dec 2025, ESTIN. Guided discussions in English and French to build confidence, communication and public speaking.
- Inter-club Yennayer celebration: Feb 2026, ESTIN. Tifinagh workshop, “Guess the Word” in Tamazight, a Yennayer quiz, traditional Kabyle dishes and clothes, and music.
- Movie Night: Dune: Feb 2026, ESTIN. A second movie night, with Dune: Part One on the big screen.
- Qa3da Musicale: 12 Feb 2026, RASA room. An open musical evening in our room to decompress after a heavy week.
- RASA Chess Cup: 15–17 Feb 2026, ESTIN. Our first chess tournament: three days of games and a champion, Sameur Adel. A new yearly rendezvous was born. (24 players)
- Tikjda trip: Apr 2026, Tikjda, Bouira. Discovering the Djurdjura mountains together, with the support of Sinay Travel and the Orca club. (656 likes on the video)
- Wishes & year retrospective: All year, Instagram. Ramadan, 8 March and Eid el-Fitr wishes, and a retrospective video thanking every member of the team.

## FAQ

### What is Rasa Club?

Rasa is the cultural and artistic club of ESTIN (École Supérieure en Sciences et Technologies de l'Informatique et du Numérique) in Amizour, Béjaïa, Algeria. It was created by students to ease the pressure of studies with a space for literature, art, music, chess, games and cultural exchange. Its motto is “Feel the emotion. Live the expression.”

### Where is Rasa Club located?

At ESTIN in Amizour, Béjaïa. The club room is on the ground floor of the ESTIN library, where many of its meetings and evenings take place.

### What departments does Rasa have?

Six departments: Literature, Art, Music, Chess, Activities and Charity, supported by the Multimedia, Communication, Logistics and Human Resources teams.

### Who leads Rasa Club in 2026/27?

The 2026/27 board is led by president Kernou Abdellah, with Zamoum Chemseddine as vice president and Slimani Sabrina as secretary. Meet the whole board.

### What events does Rasa organise?

Each season includes a Welcome Day, movie nights, a trip to the Algiers International Book Fair (SILA), the 1 November commemoration, the Speaking Club in English and French, the Yennayer celebration, musical evenings, the RASA Chess Cup and outings such as Tikjda. The club ran 11 activities in 2025/26. See all events.

### What is the RASA Chess Cup?

Rasa's chess tournament. The first edition took place at ESTIN from 15 to 17 February 2026 with 24 players; Sameur Adel won, ahead of Boukendoul Mahdi and Lahmar Mouaiz. Read the recap.

### How can I join Rasa?

Follow @rasa.estin on Instagram for every call. Registrations for 2026/27 are open to all ESTIN students: register here.

### What does Rasa's Charity Department do?

It runs solidarity campaigns with accredited associations, starting with support for children with cancer, plus causes such as blood donation, Ramadan solidarity and winter clothing collections. Rasa never collects money online. Learn more.

### How can I contact Rasa Club?

By email at rasa@estin.dz, on Instagram at @rasa.estin, or with the contact form on this website.
